# What the cfw-security-guard gates accept: <rule> <file> <count>.
#
# A (rule, file) pair that is not listed here, or that occurs more often than
# its count, fails the workflow. To accept a new finding, read it in the gate's
# log, then add or raise its line in the same pull request, so the reviewer
# sees the exception next to the code that needs it. Lower a count when the
# gate notes that it found fewer.
#
#   python3 .github/security/cfw_guard.py cxx --print-allowlist
#
# prints the current findings in this format (likewise supply-chain, and
# flawfinder with a --csv report).
#
# Seeded from the tree at e075438 (release 0.2.1): the entries below record
# what was there, they are not the result of an audit of each call.

# Process spawning: cfw::io::Process, opening a file or URL with the desktop,
# the installer starting its maintenance tool, and tests that start the
# session services they talk to (D-Bus, AT-SPI, an input method).

cxx-process-spawn            modules/cfw-app/tests/AtspiTest.cpp                      2
cxx-process-spawn            modules/cfw-app/tests/DBusTest.cpp                       2
cxx-process-spawn            modules/cfw-io/src/Process.cpp                           2
cxx-process-spawn            modules/cfw-platform/tests/X11ImeTest.cpp                2
cxx-process-spawn            tools/installer/src/main.cpp                             1
